verdict.rationale: No stated priority resolves the cost, arrival-time, connection-risk, and number-of-stops tradeoffs. A is the earliest arrival with one connection but costs more and has a tight 43-minute connection. B is slightly cheaper and has a more comfortable connection but arrives later. D is the least expensive and nearly as early as A but requires two connections. C has a substantially longer layover and later arrival, but it has only one connection and may be preferable to a traveler seeking fewer flight segments. Carry-ons and post-routing seat selection do not establish a ranking among these tradeoffs.
